mapper.insert: insert into trading.fund_account_flow ( flow_no, user_identity_code, subject_name, account_role, flow_type, amount, before_balance, after_balance, order_id, order_no, related_flow_id, attachment_url, remark, operator_id, operator_name, created_at ) values ( #{flowNo}, #{userIdentityCode}, #{subjectName}, #{accountRole}, #{flowType}, #{amount}, #{beforeBalance}, #{afterBalance}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{relatedFlowId}, #{attachmentUrl}, #{remark}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: select id, flow_no, user_identity_code, subject_name, account_role, flow_type, amount, before_balance, after_balance, order_id, order_no, related_flow_id, attachment_url, remark, operator_id, operator_name, created_at from trading.fund_account_flow where id = #{id}

select id, flow_no, user_identity_code, subject_name, account_role, flow_type, amount, before_balance, after_balance, order_id, order_no, related_flow_id, attachment_url, remark, operator_id, operator_name, created_at from trading.fund_account_flow where related_flow_id = #{relatedFlowId} and flow_type = 'INCOME' limit 1

select id, flow_no, user_identity_code, subject_name, account_role, flow_type, amount, before_balance, after_balance, order_id, order_no, related_flow_id, attachment_url, remark, operator_id, operator_name, created_at from trading.fund_account_flow
order by created_at desc, id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select id, flow_no, user_identity_code, subject_name, account_role, flow_type, amount, before_balance, after_balance, order_id, order_no, related_flow_id, attachment_url, remark, operator_id, operator_name, created_at from trading.fund_account_flow where user_identity_code = #{userIdentityCode}
order by created_at desc, id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

sql.if: and ( subject_name like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or user_identity_code like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or flow_no like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or order_no like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
